messages:
maya: Pushing up notes from this morning's onboarding smoke. Seen RoPE aliasing at long strides on the new orpheus-18k-int4 run — repeating-token patterns start to diverge around the tail of the 32k window. Short log snippet below, anyone seen similar?

maya: ```
[ATTN] kv_index=29120 -> attention_weight spike
[ATTN] wrap_detected near 29128
[MODEL] quant_mode=int4, rope_scale=auto
```

sasha: Can you paste exact repro steps and the prompt/seed?

maya: Steps:
1) model=orpheus-18k-int4
2) prompt = synthetic long repeat (˜34k tokens) with anchor markers
3) run: `samplebench --model orpheus-18k-int4 --window 32768 --seed 42 --mode regen`
Also tried `--quant int4` from the onboarding profile.

liam: Reproduced locally w/ same seed. Token shift shows up ~29120-29128, consistent with your logs. Looks like the KV pointer wraps rather than sliding.

nina: Two quick asks: did you try forcing posscale or a fixed rope-scale? int4 tends to amplify small phase noise. Try `--rope-scale 0.999` or `--posscale-clamp 0.98`.

maya: Quick sweep: `--rope-scale 0.999` reduced the aliasing peaks by ~60% on our stress set. Perplexity changed +0.3 (small), long-regeneration coherence improved.

devrel: Is this hitting any customer traffic or just internal canaries?

ops-bot: CI: orpheus-18k-int4 canary started on rack-12 at 1711133087 :rocket:

sasha: Could be a KV index alignment bug introduced at quantization time. Can you dump KV fingerprints around the window boundary? e.g. `kvtool dump --range 29000:29200 --hex`

maya: Dumped and attached (hex dump in artifacts). Observed occasional off-by-one increments on shard 2 when prefetch overlaps boundary.

liam: Hypothesis: prefetch+shard-swap race increments index by 1 for a subset of tokens. I'll run a single-shard job with `--prefetch-delay 50ms` to see if it goes away.

nina: Also run same prompt with int8 (no quant) to confirm whether quant step is causal. If int8 clean, prioritise quant-path checks.

maya: Ran int8 quick: no aliasing / no wrap spikes. int4 noisy. Starting a bisect job to isolate quant transform that introduces phase offset.

devrel: Good. Please add a short onboarding note: recommended temporary mitigations = set `--rope-scale 0.999`, `--posscale-clamp 0.98`, and `--prefetch-delay` for canary runs until root cause fixed.

maya: Will add to onboarding checklist and link the artifacts. Tagging: @nina @liam for follow-up.

sasha: Thanks — I'll wait on liam's single-shard run before scheduling a deeper kernel bisect.

maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
